items.title: The degree-one relation of a cartesian simplicial scheme is an equivalence relation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Equivalence-relation lemma (statement 6798-6809, proof 6811-6872): the four defining properties of an equivalence relation are each argued in the span - monomorphism via the cartesian identification, transitivity via the composition morphism built from the (d^2_2, d^2_0) isomorphism, reflexivity via the diagonal, symmetry via the (d^2_2, d^2_1) isomorphism; the two 'Details omitted.' passages are auxiliary fibre-product rewirings whose cause (cartesianness of pi) is named and one instance displayed. H2.
